Lambson family · Person

Glenn Cody Lambson

1898–1934

Open in the family tree

Born
January 26, 1898 · Springville, Utah
Died
June 18, 1934 · Bingham Canyon, Utah
Burial
Mount Olivet Cemetery, Salt Lake City, Utah

Born in Springville and died in Bingham Canyon. His sister Clara recalled that he went to war in France. Military records have yet to confirm that account.

Glenn Cody married Mary Lucille Jamieson on September 11, 1922, in Salt Lake City. Their children were Norma Lucille, Vera Elaine, and Glenn Jamieson. His sister Clara recalled that he went to war in France. Military records have yet to confirm that account.
